scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.description: Ready session, no input: 10 s of audio.

scenarios.name: trig1-hold
scenarios.description: QA prelude (NO, NO, encoder A), then Audition Trig 1 (button 25) pressed at +60M instructions and held to the end: 10 s of audio. One voice. The prelude is not needed on the current ready state: trig1-noqa-40m sounds without it.

scenarios.name: kb-chord16
scenarios.description: QA prelude, keyboard mode on (button 18 tapped at +50M), then all 16 trig keys (25..40) pressed at +60M and held to the end: up to 16 chromatic voices, 10 s of audio. Best-effort heavy load: the DSP cost is dominated by a constant background, so the extra voices add only a little CPU, but the PCM RMS is well above trig1-hold.

scenarios.name: exactness-100m
scenarios.description: Validation, not a load: the coupled_ready_exactness workload (QA prelude, Trig 1 down at +60M, up at +100M, ended at +100M instructions, as NOTE_EVENTS=trig). PCM must hash to the value the test asserts.

scenarios.name: trig1-noqa-40m
scenarios.description: Validation, not a load: desktop_trig1_capture_without_qa_script (Trig 1 held from ready for 40M instructions, no prelude). With the 2026-10-06 ready snapshot (pSLC card, no SLC dialog) it sounds (rms 0.60). The 2026-10-03 snapshot (4G MLC card, DIGI_CARD_IDENTITY=mlc4g) stayed silent behind the SLC dialog, hash a50586e86b2d0246bd05181dd1f877b1b2570f2c1eb74b7613c9b17dbd4eb75a.

scenarios.name: trig1-taps
scenarios.description: Three Trig 1 taps (0.3 s hold each, the desktop Audition default) without the QA script; 10 s. The NO press (button 12) at 0 is kept so the pinned hash stays valid; the current ready state does not need it (trig1-noqa-40m sounds without it). Trig events are offset by 60M.

scenarios.name: trig1-tap-release
scenarios.description: One Trig 1 tap, then 8 s of release and idle (the desktop 'sine then noise' case). The NO press (button 12) at 0 is kept so the pinned hash stays valid; the current ready state does not need it (trig1-noqa-40m sounds without it). Trig events are offset by 60M.
